en.headline: Education Bureau updates guide to discourage grade retention for SEN students
en.dek: The revised School Administration Guide says schools should avoid repeating grades for students with special educational needs, citing risks to social and emotional adaptation and mental health.
body: The Education Bureau has updated its School Administration Guide for aided schools, strengthening advice against grade retention, particularly for students with special educational needs.

The guide states that schools should try to avoid repeating grades for any student and especially should not arrange repeated retention. It specifically says schools should not arrange grade retention for students with special educational needs, particularly those with intellectual developmental disorder or serious mental illness, because the arrangement would only intensify their social and emotional adaptation difficulties and raise mental health risks.

It adds that without appropriate counselling and follow-up, grade retention would only have negative effects on students. When considering retention for a student with special educational needs, schools must discuss the matter with parents through a cross-professional team to ensure the decision is in the student’s best interests, and may seek views from other professionals such as psychiatrists if needed.

The bureau has long set overall grade-retention rate ceilings of 3 per cent for primary schools and 5 per cent for secondary schools. The latest revision also reiterates that large numbers of retained students should not be concentrated in any single form.

zh.headline: 教育局更新學校行政手冊 提醒學校避免安排特殊教育需要學生留級
zh.dek: 修訂後的手冊指學校應盡量避免讓學生留級，尤其不應安排有特殊教育需要的學生留級，以免加劇社交情緒適應困難及增加精神健康風險。
body: 教育局更新適用於資助學校的《學校行政手冊》，加強對留級安排的指引，特別針對有特殊教育需要的學生。
手冊指出，學校應盡量避免讓學生留級，尤其不應重複留級。內文明確提到，學校不應安排有特殊教育需要的學生留級，特別是有智力發展障礙或有嚴重精神疾病的學生，因為留級只會加劇他們的社交情緒適應困難，增加精神健康風險。
手冊強調，如無適切輔導及跟進工作，留級只會對學生造成負面影響。在考慮有特殊教育需要學生的留級安排時，學校須透過跨專業團隊與家長商討，確保決定符合學生的最大利益，如有需要亦可參考精神科醫生等其他專業人士的意見。
教育局一直規定小學和中學的全校留級率分別不超過百分之三及百分之五。今次修訂亦重申，不應將大量留級生集中在個別年級。
